metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting active fires near Paradise, California during November 7-10, 2018. This is a specific time period during the devastating Camp Fire that started on November 8, 2018. For fire detection, I should use: 1. MODIS Active Fire Data (MODIS/006/MCD14ML) - this is specifically designed for fire detection 2. VIIRS Active Fire Data (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML) - higher resolution alternative Strategy: - Define geometry around Paradise, CA (point with buffer) - Query active fire collections for the date range - Check if any fire detections exist in the area - Count fire pixels to determine presence Data quality considerations: - Check if collections have data for this period - Validate fire detection confidence - Handle potential missing data by trying both MODIS and VIIRS The question is binary - was there an active fire present (yes/no). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions paradise = ee.Geometry.Point(-121.6219, 39.7596).buffer(20000) # 20km buffer around Paradise start_date = '2018-11-07' end_date = '2018-11-10' # 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS first (higher resolution) viirs_fires = ee.FeatureCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(paradise) # Check if VIIRS has data if viirs_fires.size().getInfo() == 0: # Fallback to MODIS modis_fires = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(paradise) if modis_fires.size().getInfo() == 0: print("VIIRS fires: 0, MODIS fires: 0") print("B") else: # Count MODIS fire detections modis_count = modis_fires.size().getInfo() print(f"MODIS fire detections: {modis_count}") print("A") else: # Count VIIRS fire detections viirs_count = viirs_fires.size().getInfo() print(f"VIIRS fire detections: {viirs_count}") print("A") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
paradise = ee.Geometry.Point(-121.6219, 39.7596).buffer(20000)  # 20km buffer around Paradise
start_date = '2018-11-07'
end_date = '2018-11-10'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS first (higher resolution)
viirs_fires = ee.FeatureCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(paradise)

# Check if VIIRS has data
if viirs_fires.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Fallback to MODIS
    modis_fires = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(paradise)
    
    if modis_fires.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("VIIRS fires: 0, MODIS fires: 0")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
    else:
        # Count MODIS fire detections
        modis_count = modis_fires.size().getInfo()
        print(f"MODIS fire detections: {modis_count}")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    # Count VIIRS fire detections
    viirs_count = viirs_fires.size().getInfo()
    print(f"VIIRS fire detections: {viirs_count}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
